name: @reedchan/statusline
description: Replaces pi's footer with a labelled two-row status line: context pressure as a fixed-size meter, cache and cost, the model and effort level, and the latest turn's TTFT and decode throughput in tokens/second. An opt-in panel (ctrl+q or /breakdown) breaks
